changelog: StarBorder Redesign & Off-White Color: Replaced blue border with elegant off-white starlight particle with dynamic stardust trail that orbits smoothly around the chat input card
Zero-Allocation Animation Pipeline: Pre-allocated geometry buffers and path caching in StarBorder to eliminate per-frame garbage collection stutter
FloatingLines Power Pacing: Cached sRGB linear stops in the GPU render loop and added visibility-based hibernation to reduce idle background battery usage to zero
DecryptedText & ShinyText Polish: Pre-allocated gradient color buffers and converted DecryptedText to zero-overhead plain Text once resolution completes
